title: Turtle with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Shell - green dome -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='30' ry='22' fill='#2E8B57'/>
  <!-- Shell pattern - lighter green hexagons -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='18' ry='12' fill='#3CB371'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#90EE90'/>
  <!-- Shell rim - yellow-green band -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='30' ry='22' fill='none' stroke='#7CCD7C' stroke-width='4'/>
  <!-- Head - light green -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='48' rx='12' ry='11' fill='#8FBC8F'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <rect x='66' y='46' width='10' height='8' rx='3' fill='#8FBC8F'/>
  <!-- Eyes - white with sparkles -->
  <ellipse cx='78' cy='44' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <ellipse cx='84' cy='46' rx='4' ry='4.5' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <!-- Pupils -->
  <circle cx='79' cy='44' r='2.3' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='85' cy='46' r='2.3' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <!-- Sparkles (stars) in eyes -->
  <g fill='#FFFFFF'>
    <polygon points='78,41 78.5,42.5 80,42.5 78.8,43.3 79.2,44.8 78,43.8 76.8,44.8 77.2,43.3 76,42.5 77.5,42.5'/>
    <polygon points='84,43 84.5,44.5 86,44.5 84.8,45.3 85.2,46.8 84,45.8 82.8,46.8 83.2,45.3 82,44.5 83.5,44.5'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Mouth - small smile -->
  <path d='M78 52 Q82 56 86 52' fill='none' stroke='#556B2F' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Front legs -->
  <ellipse cx='68' cy='70' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8FBC8F'/>
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='70' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8FBC8F'/>
  <!-- Back legs -->
  <ellipse cx='25' cy='68' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#8FBC8F'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <polygon points='20,58 12,55 15,60' fill='#8FBC8F'/>
  <!-- Toes -->
  <g fill='#556B2F'>
    <circle cx='63' cy='73' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='66' cy='74' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='69' cy='73' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='31' cy='73' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='34' cy='74' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='37' cy='73' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='21' cy='70' r='1.2'/>
    <circle cx='24' cy='71' r='1.2'/>
  </g>
  <!-- Belly/plastron hint -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='18' ry='6' fill='#B8E0B8'/>
</svg>
